supporting_observations.claim: At 14:16:09 UTC, explorer.exe wrote a UserAssist registry entry for ivy.chen whose ROT13-encoded path resolves to C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe. This supports that a PowerShell-related UserAssist entry was updated, but does not establish when PowerShell was launched or what it did.

At 13:40–13:41 UTC, proxy records show ivy.chen's Chrome browser accessing login.salesforce.com and its page resources. This is browser activity around the reported time, but does not explain the reported PowerShell window.

At 13:26:57 UTC, WS-ICHEN-01 made a short proxy tunnel to desktop.dropbox.com with the user agent DropboxUpdate/199.4.6287. Dropbox is not among the approved services in the supplied inventory; this is an unexplained policy deviation, but the record alone does not establish malicious activity or file transfer.

At 13:51:02 UTC, FILE-NWD-01 attempted a TCP connection to WS-ICHEN-01 on port 9997; the connection record shows S0 and zero bytes in both directions. The available record does not show a successful connection or its purpose.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied sensor status reports a collection outage for both winsec and Sysmon on WS-ICHEN-01 from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC. This covers the reported 13:40 window, so endpoint process creation and related Windows events during that period are unavailable.
The UserAssist registry event occurs after the reported time and does not provide a command line, script contents, or a definitive PowerShell execution time.
Proxy and network records provide some activity context, but do not identify the process responsible for most connections or establish the contents and purpose of encrypted traffic.
claims_not_established: Whether PowerShell actually appeared at approximately 13:40 UTC, and, if so, which process or user action launched it.
Whether a PowerShell command or script ran, what it contained, or whether it made changes.

Whether the activity was authorized workstation patching. The supplied practice describes patching from WS-SOKAFOR-01, but the available records do not establish that this procedure occurred on WS-ICHEN-01.
Whether the Dropbox updater connection involved a file transfer, and whether it was related to the reported alert.
Why FILE-NWD-01 attempted the connection to port 9997 or whether any related activity succeeded.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover or obtain endpoint EDR/process telemetry for WS-ICHEN-01 covering 13:30–14:10 UTC, especially process creation, parent-child relationships, command lines, and PowerShell activity.
Collect PowerShell Operational logs, including script-block and module logging if available, plus relevant EDR or command-history data.
Obtain the UserAssist value data and corroborating execution artifacts, such as Prefetch and Amcache, to help determine whether and when PowerShell ran.
Review WS-SOKAFOR-01 and FILE-NWD-01 logs for the scheduled patching procedure, access to Apply-Updates.ps1, and activity involving WS-ICHEN-01 during the window.
Investigate the Dropbox updater's installation and execution context, and review proxy or endpoint evidence for any associated file transfer.
Review FILE-NWD-01 telemetry for the purpose and initiating process of the connection attempt to WS-ICHEN-01:9997.
